claims.claim: SemiAnalysis said TPU and Trainium are now on InferenceX/AgentX, delivering 1.2x to 2.5x the performance per dollar of Nvidia GPUs; a later post said 1.5-2.5x 'at release'.
Jensen Huang said on the Dwarkesh Podcast that TPU and Trainium would not come to InferenceMAX and invited them to demonstrate their inference cost.
Trainium3 UltraServer showed up to 2.28x the performance per dollar of GB300 NVL72, B300 and MI355X on AgentX with GLM-5.2/5.3 744B FP4 on vLLM, as a preview result.
SemiAnalysis modeled cost per chip-hour: GB300 $2.31, B300 $2.26, GB200 $1.86, MI355X $1.50, Trainium3 $1.05.
At the 2.28x point Trainium3 produced about 9,266 total tokens per chip-second versus about 8,942 for GB300 NVL72; P90 TTFT 4.5 s vs 1.8 s.
At each curve's peak Trainium3 reaches about 31,045 tokens per chip-second and GB300 about 63,647.
Trainium3's advantage is about 1.98x at ~140 tok/s/user, 2.18x at ~190, 2.28x at ~250 and 2.01x at ~350.

SemiAnalysis: Trainium3 PDS + vLLM is better than every accelerator besides Vera Rubin across the entire TCO vs p90 interactivity curve; Trn3 has 17% of Blackwell Ultra FP4 FLOPS and 61% of its bandwidth at about 30% of the TCO.
SemiAnalysis models Trainium3 + vLLM profit margin at 73.5% vs 53% for GB300 + SGLang at 135 tok/s/user, assuming 3-year rental prices, Z.ai list token prices and 60% utilization.
On the Internal basis Trainium3 is $0.83 per chip-hour vs $3.61 for Vera Rubin NVL72, and Vera Rubin delivers 3.3x the tokens per dollar of Trainium3 at 273 tok/s/user.

Ironwood delivers up to 50% better performance per dollar than B200/B300 at FP8; at 100 tok/s/user cost is $0.181 vs $0.222 vs $0.276 per million tokens; at 20 tok/s/user throughput is 9,364 vs 8,903 vs 8,925 tokens/s/chip.
On external TCO Ironwood's tokens-per-dollar lead is 50.4% over B200 and 96.0% over B300; on internal TCO ($1.03/chip-hour) it is 76.7% and 130.2%.

SemiAnalysis: across most of the raw-performance curve TPU does not outperform Nvidia GPUs; GB300 NVL72 disagg has about a 30% perf per dollar advantage over TPUv7 agg mid-curve; mean TTFT at concurrency 256 is 5.41 s TPU vs 2.40 s B300.

On Kimi K3 GB300 FP4 leads TPUv7 by 1.5x-2.6x after four Nvidia refreshes; on GLM at 100 tok/s/user GB300 and GB200 FP4 deliver 3.6x and 3.5x TPUv7's tokens per dollar; VR200 delivers 4.3x-5.6x TPUv7; TPUv7 FP8 is 1.67x better per dollar than FP4 GB300 on Qwen3.5.
Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered 9.11x GB300 NVL72's tokens per dollar of TCO at 200 tok/s/user on GLM-5.3, priced at $3.61 vs $2.31 per chip-hour (preview).
SemiAnalysis: 3-year rental cost in July 2026 was over $8.5/hr/chip for Rubin and $5/hr/chip for Blackwell Ultra NVL72.
AWS Capacity Block per-accelerator prices: trn2 $2.235, p5 H100 $5.970, p5e H200 $6.866, p5en $7.895, p6-b200 $14.208, p6-b300 $16.146, GB200 NVL72 $10.582.
AWS publishes no hourly price for Trn3; Trn3 UltraServers scale to 144 chips, 144 GB HBM3e and 4.9 TB/s per chip.
Ironwood list price reportedly $12.00 per chip-hour on demand in Iowa, $8.40 1-yr, $5.40 3-yr; SemiAnalysis estimated Anthropic's contract rate at roughly $1.60 per TPU-hour.
CoreWeave on-demand: GB200 NVL72 $42.00 per 4-GPU instance, B200 $68.80 per 8 GPUs; up to 60% discounts for commitments.
Vast.ai median rentable ask: B300 $10.63, B200 $9.06, H200 $5.26 per GPU-hour.
Azure ND GB200 v6 East US is $108.16 per VM-hour pay-as-you-go.
Jassy Q1 2026: Trainium2 has about 30% better price-performance than comparable GPUs and Trainium3 is 30-40% more price-performant than Trainium2.
AWS says Trn2 offers 30-40% better price performance than GPU-based P5e and P5en instances.
Anthropic agreed to use up to 1 million TPUs with well over a gigawatt online in 2026, and uses TPUs, Trainium and Nvidia GPUs.
Anthropic will use up to 5 GW of Trainium capacity and commits more than $100B to AWS over 10 years.
Anthropic committed $30B to Azure for up to 1 GW of Nvidia Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems; Nvidia invests up to $10B.
OpenAI committed to consume approximately 2 GW of Trainium capacity through AWS, after a $38B Nvidia GPU deal.
AgentX traces come from opt-in Claude Code sessions with median requests of about 142k input tokens and 444 output tokens.
InferenceX cost per million tokens = TCO $/chip-hour x 1,000,000 / (3600 x tok/s/chip); external TCO includes the vendor margin, internal excludes it.
Ironwood: 4,614 FP8 TFLOPS, 192 GB HBM, 7.37 TB/s per chip, 9,216 chips per pod.
Trainium3 rows carry no run link, commit or public logs while GB300 rows link to recorded GitHub runs.
Cohere and Stability AI found Trainium less competitive than Nvidia GPUs per a leaked July 2025 Amazon document.
Nvidia Q3 FY27 revenue $115.8B, Data Center $107.6B, GAAP gross margin 74.8%; Q4 guide 71.0-72.0%.
Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on 12 November 2026 with Colette Kress as interim CEO, and the board reinstated him as President and CEO on 23 November 2026.

A machine transcript of Broadcom's fiscal Q3 2026 call gives semiconductor segment gross margin as approximately 56.7% after a corrected ~76%; a high-60s figure would fit the 75% consolidated margin; Hock Tan said customers can do this at half the cost of a GPU.
A follow-up SemiAnalysis post described Google and Amazon as demonstrating 1.5-2.5x better perf per dollar at release versus equivalent Nvidia GPUs.
